Privacy notice for early-access build 0.1.0 · 20 October 2026

Publisher and contact

O. Bankole is the publisher. Contact banksmi@mail.com for privacy or support questions.

What is stored

Book metadata, reading sessions, notes, goals and settings are stored on your device. Imported PDF and EPUB files are copied into app-private storage. No account is required. Android automatic backup is disabled for this build.

Network services

Optional book metadata search sends the entered query to Open Library over HTTPS. The app does not send notes, document files or reading history for analytics. Android speech recognition and text-to-speech are provided by installed engines, whose processing and network behaviour depend on those providers. The app itself saves no microphone recordings.

Your choices

Microphone access is requested only for spoken commands. Notifications are optional. Export destinations are chosen through Android’s document picker; those destinations may be cloud providers you choose. Ordinary JSON, CSV, Markdown, text and PDF exports are unencrypted. Optional local encrypted backups use AES-256-GCM with a passphrase derived using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 210,000 iterations, and a random salt and IV. Passphrases are not stored and cannot be recovered. Document files are excluded from backups.

Deletion and retention

Records remain until you delete them, clear app storage or uninstall. Delete all local data removes the local database records and imported documents. It cannot remove exports you previously saved elsewhere.

Payments and analytics

This build has no active purchase flow, ads, third-party analytics SDK or cloud backup. Any future changes require an updated notice. This notice is a product disclosure draft and should be reviewed before a store release.
